description: Endless 3D wireframe dogfight at the edge of a black hole, made in Barquisimeto, Venezuela, by juanevillam. Loop, dive and barrel-roll through three sectors (Avila, Catatumbo, Salto Angel) of kamikazes, snipers and minefields; lure ships into the black hole, chain flight gates, unleash Overdrive, and bring down a destroyer that keeps jumping back out of hyperspace. Survive. Score.
